notes: οὗτος is substantival with no article present, so it takes The same whole, headed on same under rules 38 and 49.
ἔχει πίστιν is split under rule 2 rather than joined under rule 73, the ASV spelling both elements out as had and faith.
σωθῆναι → to be made whole heads on whole, the meaning-bearing complement, and the nominalizing τοῦ stands unrepresented under rule 61.
